messages.content: Turn my wolffish notes into a short deck for Thursday — seven slides at most, and put the depth numbers in a chart.

segments.delta: Seven slides is the right length for a twenty-minute slot. Title, the one-paragraph framing, the traits that matter, the species table, the depth chart, the distribution picture, then a closing note.
Built it around the five species in your notes — seven slides, with the depth comparison as a chart rather than another table.

Slide 5 is the one to rehearse: the depth ranges overlap more than the table suggests, and the chart makes that obvious. I also left the species table on slide 4 so you have the numbers on screen if anyone asks.
